messages.text: Need a Travel Scroll to The Rift?
messages.zh: 需要一张前往裂隙的旅行卷轴吗?

messages.raw: §fYou can't activate it here...too much magic in the air I guess?
messages.text: You can't activate it here...too much magic in the air I guess?
messages.zh: 这里用不了它……大概是空气里的魔法太多了吧?

messages.raw: §fBut it's §5Rift Transferable§f! That hand-stand §5Dark Auction§f man in the §aWyld Woods§f can help you get it back to the real world.
messages.text: But it's Rift Transferable! That hand-stand Dark Auction man in the Wyld Woods can help you get it back to the real world.
messages.zh: 不过它可以跨裂隙转移! 那个倒立着的暗黑拍卖会家伙就在异野森林，他能帮你把它带回现实世界。
